limitations: Synthetic validation of metadata normalization and necessary temporal conditions only. No returned API metadata, real flux, image or Gaia rows inspected.
Canonical string identities tested through the same json.loads(parse_int=str) route used by analyzer.main; arbitrary unvalidated mixed-type identity input is outside this API path.
Metadata-identical repeats cannot reveal photometric conflicts. Passing temporal conditions does not establish baseline precision or scientific evaluability.
